group.Description: NWB ElectrodeGroup name of the contact (the source stores each macro contact as its own group, Neuralynx-Atlas-macros-N).

low_cutoff.Description: Hardware high-pass of the acquisition (Keles et al. 2024).

high_cutoff.Description: Anti-aliasing low-pass applied by the authors before decimation to 1000 Hz (Keles et al. 2024).

source_origchannel.Description: NWB electrodes table column origchannel (original channel ID, macro-N).

source_electrode_row.Description: Zero-based row of the NWB electrodes table referenced by the LFP_macro ElectricalSeries electrode region for this column.
